detail.body:
QA resilience: Who do I call if LedgerOne is down?
Who do I call if LedgerOne is down?

If LedgerOne is down, contact the payments ops duty manager first [1]. If the outage lasts more than 30 minutes, escalate to the LedgerOne vendor hotline [1].

“On-call escalation goes to the payments ops duty manager first, then to the LedgerOne vendor hotline if it's still down after thirty minutes. The hotline is useless before then.”

Original

“The reconciliation report from LedgerOne is always wrong on the first business day of the month, because of a timezone bug. Rerun it after ten a.m. Eastern and it comes out right.”

Original
